# Competency questions — Event Core 0.2.0

| Question | Representation / checked boundary |
|---|---|
| Can a source-only report remain unresolved? | EventCandidate/InterpretationCandidate; absent or unknown observations, no StateSnapshot or Delta required. |
| Is a citation enough to admit a snapshot? | No. SourceSnapshotOrigin needs explicit graph-bound confirmation with confirm-source capability. |
| How is direct capture distinguished? | DirectObservationOrigin has observer, artifact identity and time/clock; captured record states must match record boundaries. Authenticity remains unverified. |
| How does an operator supply states? | OperatorSnapshotOrigin retains operator/rationale; the same operator needs supply-operator-state in the exact scope/projection. |
| Can a snapshot be supplied without origin? | No under eventcore-provenance-v1, including empty or currently unreferenced snapshots. v1 remains unchanged. |
| Can unknown data silently become an empty complete state? | No. Typed origin, confirmation and separate enrichment authority are required. No states are generated by validation. |
| Are known and partial data preserved? | Known snapshot identity remains fixed; partial proposition/polarity facts must remain in the corresponding complete state. |
| Does review authorize enrichment? | No. Only an explicit admitted candidate-record edge may support interpretation resolution. |
| What is the receipt bound to? | Exact graph bytes, graph/revision and profile pin; any byte change requires reconfirmation. |
| Does admitted provenance prove truth? | No. Presence of source, confirmation under supplied authority, authenticity and factual truth remain different claims. |
| Does this change eventcore-v1 history? | No. Explicit profile/IR selection; no auto-upgrade or report migration. |
